studies.title: The astrolabe in the Islamic world
studies.caption: Astronomers of Abbasid Baghdad build and refine the astrolabe, a brass model of the sky for telling time and measuring the height of stars.
studies.prompt: Close study of an Abbasid scholar holding a rigid flat brass planispheric astrolabe almost face-on. A circular rim, coplanar rete and engraved backing plate, shared centre pivot and straight rule make its geometry clear; hands support the suspension ring and lower outer edge without bending the disk.
